reviewer_statement: Developer-scoped scientific source contract review of paired direct Python 1.2 numeric fold/results tests, canonical provenance, grouped and shuffled source policies. Source-equivalent Python Statsmodels object and arbitrary input/exception domains are not claimed; exact-head CI and independent certification remain pending.
native_language_semantic_policy: Real native R FPCA+OLS/binomial GLM fitted inside training folds; NumPy RandomState curve shuffle and declared GroupKFold NumPy sort policy, source-shaped tables and six ordered scientific provenance keys. Native R fitted object class and backend do not pretend Python statsmodels/NumPy execution occurred. Default native R returns original extended diagnostics.

case_evidence.description: Frozen eyetrajectoriespy Python 1.2 prediction.py::cross_validate_fpca_regression with explicit 1-2 FPC candidate counts, train-only FPCA, Gaussian OLS or Bernoulli statsmodels-GLM scientific equivalent, complete held-out prediction and fold assessments. Supports declared curve shuffle and grouped CV.

Complete common-grid trajectories, numeric aligned optional scalar covariates, candidate FPC counts, explicit Gaussian or 0/1 binomial response, explicit curve KFold / group GroupKFold, source-compatible shuffled MT19937 and declared NumPy tie-order profile. R-only explicit fold assignments/text parsing are excluded in strict mode.

Frozen Python 1.2 public-export direct tests compare expected fold assignments, Gaussian or binomial held-out probabilities, fold losses, nested component selection and outer predictions with numeric tolerance 1e-5 on independent inputs. Python 1.2 oracle tests are committed but not yet confirmed green in exact-head CI.

Strict mode rejects malformed strict flag, R-only supplied fold indices, R-only optional pandas numeric-text coercions, native base-R shuffled RNG, missing group tie-order profile. Underlying source-compatible validations reject malformed group columns, candidate support, invalid binomial outcomes and underdetermined folds, but Python exception class identity is excluded.

Canonical 12-field scientific FPCARegressionCVResult analogue with fold_losses, assignments, predictions and exactly six frozen Python provenance fields (method, fit_fpca_inside_fold, fit_regression_inside_fold, group_leakage_prevented, covariates, scientific_warning).

Train-only unsupervised FPCA and held-out scalar response predictions/risks from KFold/GroupKFold; no held-out outcomes used in fitting, binomial link logit and Gaussian OLS, with group leakage prevention where requested.

independent_review_status: Provisional developer review only; CI tests not confirmed passing and no independent certificate.
language_specific_limits: Native R and Python dataclass/NumPy object runtime identity and exception/warning classes differ.
Binomial source uses Statsmodels GLM while native R uses stats::glm.fit, so full-domain IRLS boundary and extreme separation behavior remain unverified.
GroupKFold tie order depends on NumPy build; larger tied cohorts need further qualification. Strict mode requires an explicit documented NumPy tie-order policy.
Optional R-specific explicit fold assignments and numeric-text covariate parsing are not frozen Python public-call inputs; strict mode forbids them.
Source tests and six-domain receipt are developer-prepared, not an independent certification; no R CMD check or CRAN claim.
